chosen.summary: The interval check accepts every value.
assumptions: low is less than or equal to high.

findings.title: Interval bounds are joined with OR
findings.explanation: Every integer is either at least low or at most high, so the predicate does not enforce both bounds.
findings.suggested_fix: Use value >= low && value <= high to require that value lies within the interval.

chosen.summary: Exact page multiples produce an extra page.
assumptions: item_count is non-negative and per_page is positive.

findings.title: Unconditional extra page
findings.explanation: When item_count divides evenly by per_page, integer division already yields the required number of pages.
findings.suggested_fix: Use (item_count + per_page - 1) / per_page for positive inputs.

chosen.summary: The enabled operation leaves the disabled bit set.
assumptions: Disabled marks a feature that must be cleared before it is enabled.

findings.title: Enable operation sets the disabled bit
findings.explanation: Bitwise OR adds the Disabled bit and cannot remove it from flags.
findings.suggested_fix: Use flags & ~Disabled to clear the bit before enabling the feature.

chosen.summary: The minute component is subtracted instead of added.
assumptions: hours and minutes describe a non-negative elapsed duration, with minutes below 60.

findings.title: Minute component reduces the total
findings.explanation: Subtracting minutes makes 1 hour 30 minutes evaluate to 30 rather than 90.
